# José Roberto Rodríguez Duque

> Salvadoran startup ecosystem builder and CEO of CoreNest Accelerator El Salvador. He connects founders, companies, investors and government so startups from El Salvador and Central America can grow fast, scale across Latin America and reach an exit.

## About
José Roberto Rodríguez Duque (also written José Roberto Rodríguez, José Rodríguez or Roberto Duque; Instagram @joserobduque) is based in El Salvador and works mostly in El Salvador and Central America, and across Latin America. He has 20 years of experience building businesses, starting with his first one at 16. He co-founded Impact Hub San Salvador, whose programs supported more than 3,500 micro, small and medium businesses. He led 11 Salvadoran startups to New York (May 2024), a 37-person delegation of startups, government and companies to Web Summit Lisbon (November 2024) and a delegation to Web Summit Rio (2025). Since July 2025 he has been CEO of CoreNest Accelerator El Salvador, which received more than 700 applications from 22 countries. He is an alumnus of the U.S. International Visitor Leadership Program (IVLP, 2022) and holds a master's degree in Project Management (EAE Business School and Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya, Barcelona) and a degree in Industrial Engineering (UCA, El Salvador).

## What he does
- Startup acceleration: for technology startups that want to grow fast across Latin America and sell their company within about four years.
- Corporate innovation through startups: companies bring real challenges, startups solve them through measurable pilots.
- Co-investment: investment follows a successful corporate pilot, with co-investors from Central America and Latin America.
- Ecosystem missions: delegations of startups, government and companies to global events and investor hubs.
- Speaking: talks and panels in Spanish and English.

## Work
- CoreNest Accelerator El Salvador (2025 to today): CEO, https://corenest.com/sv
- Impact Hub San Salvador (2017 to 2025): operations manager, then partner and co-founder
- Delta Members, later Alpha Ventures (2024 to 2025): the first club of Salvadoran founders, which he founded; a community at Impact Hub San Salvador for startups that had raised more than $100,000, including N1CO, Boxful, Ábaco and Fruto Infinito: https://sansalvador.impacthub.net/alpha-ventures
- R2P, Ready to Pitch: startup pitch events he launched at Impact Hub San Salvador
- Acelera Empresaria: business acceleration program for Salvadoran women he took part in
- Sayhello (2017 to 2025): co-founder of a digital agency, sold in 2025, now MAYNDS
- City Experience (2014 to 2017): co-founded in Barcelona, launched in El Salvador in 2015, franchised in Central America and the Caribbean
